<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Reverberating Spell](/Feats.aspx?ID=4347) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Spellshape" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=513" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 59

**Archetype** [Elementalist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=207)

**Prerequisites**
[Elementalist Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4340); metal is in your elemental philosophy

</column>

---

Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor. If the next action you use this turn is to Cast a non-cantrip Spell that deals damage in an area (such as a burst, line, or cone), the spell deals an additional 1d8 sonic damage and all creatures who fail their save against the spell are [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=8) for 1 round. Targets who critically fail their saves against this spell are instead deafened for 1 minute. The spell gains the [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147) trait.
name: Reverberating Spell
prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; metal is in your elemental philosophy
